description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1. What is the Church's position in regards to Ministers (Especially pastors) eating animal flesh? Has it neglected the Counsel from the Prophetess?
2. This has been a hard subject for me to grasp my mind around. It seems very deep and complicated. Please provide a short version, juiced version of what LGT simply is, and if we are to have the LGT characteristics for the day of the Lord to come?
3. Kindly explain to me the 1290 and 1335 days found in Daniel 12.
4. During Jesus's time there were a lot of demon activities.  Some people's illnesses were due to demon possession and Jesus cast out the demons.
   A)  Can our pastors cast out demons
  B)  That today some diseases are due to demon possession
  C) Can good angels possess human beings like satan's angels
5. My question is, is it right for church members, e.g, the elders, deacons, deaconesses, or choir members to sit on the pulpit during worship services?
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
